selfAudit.correction: Js8s on 6s5sQd6dAs is a made J-high flush on the river, not a missed flush draw. The original initial-review sentence claiming a confirmed missed-draw bluff is false and must not be used as evidence. Frozen initial file is preserved; this correction supersedes that sentence.
76 on T84 already has double-gutshot 5 or 9; original reason understated it as backdoor-only. Check in a five-way pot remains defensible, but the equity description was wrong.
65 on K938 has a gutshot to 7; original reason incorrectly said no direct straight draw. Check is still reasonable multiway; do not treat that as no equity.
K9 on J63Q draws to a K-high straight with T, not the nut straight: AK can make Broadway on the same T. Flush completion can also dominate.

Calling 55 through three small barrels on T4472 is a deliberate bluff catch, but no direct evidence established enough B bluffs. Turn/river defence may be too loose. This concern follows range and evidence limits, not the revealed loss alone.
Some overlimps with weak suited or offsuit holdings may realize poorly in a table that often isolates. They were genuine low-price decisions, but not proven optimal.
